verdict.rationale: Rippling documents extensive rule-based automation triggering on events—role changes, offboarding, security threats, device thresholds—via dynamic rules and custom workflows (docs-3, docs-7, docs-8, docs-11, docs-18, docs-27 'You define the rules, Rippling runs the rest'). This directly matches the story's ask for user-defined rules triggering automated actions on events.  Missing for 10: no evidence of a general-purpose, user-facing rule builder/editor UI or documentation showing arbitrary custom event-condition-action definitions beyond the pre-built automation categories, and no independent/hands-on verification of rule customization depth.
